capabilities: Visualize person notes from frontmatter as an interactive relationship map with orbit and space layouts
Filter people by frontmatter properties and shared group definitions
Create notes for potential contacts from a configurable template and folder
Crop person photos non-destructively and export the graph as PNG
Embed the graph as a custom view in Bases
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README states it works locally, makes no network requests, and collects no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view notes about people as a relationship map with roles, photos, companies, and groups derived from frontmatter.

relations.evidence: With the Bases core plugin enabled, select Person Network as a Bases view.

summary: Interactive relationship map of people in the vault, built from frontmatter, with orbit and space layouts, filtering, and Bases view support.
